🎬 AI 音乐视频工作流程（ComfyUI）

将您最喜爱的曲目变成完全由 AI 生成的曲目电影音乐视频— 自动在 ComfyUI 内 —无需后期编辑。
此工作流程需要参考图像和一个音频文件，然后生成与歌词、情绪和场景动态相匹配的口型同步视频，并且 95% 完全自动化。

由于某种原因，大多数示例视频都没有显示，猜测它们太长了。你都可以找到它们这里

可以找到高级演练这里

需要帮助或有疑问吗？请通过不和谐联系

✨ 它有什么作用

  • 🎭 保留你的参考图像作为所有场景的主要表演者。

  • 🎶 将音频分割成歌词同步的片段，以实现完美的时机。

  • 🖋️ 使用自定义提示创建器节点，将自定义指令发送到 LLM 节点，以根据歌词和您的风格选择构建电影提示。

  • 🎥 生成逐个场景的视觉效果，然后将它们组合成无缝的最终视频。

我提供的示例都是在 ComfyUI 内创建的，没有任何后期编辑。

在 5090 上，完整的歌曲大约需要 2 小时。

可以找到更多示例这里当我制作它们时，还会添加更多。

🔧 主要特点

  • 参考图像控制- 导入您的角色照片（推荐爆头），它会自动删除背景，并调整大小以实现清晰的取景。

  • 音频处理– 自动人声/乐器分离、Whisper V3 转录、歌词重叠的高级设置和后备选项。

  • 提示创建者- 灵活的场景构建器，包含风格、主题、灯光、相机运动、服装等字段，以获得自定义外观

  • 自动排队– 无缝处理长音频文件的多次运行视频。

  • 最终渲染自动化- 收集所有视频块，合并它们，并将完成的视频保存为最终视频.mp4.

  • 此工作流程使用 Native Gemini LLM API节点默认情况下，它接收 Prompt Creator 节点生成的详细指令。如果您愿意，您可以将 Gemini 换成另一个法学硕士，但指令集相当复杂，并且大多数本地模型都难以可靠地遵循它们。如果您根本不想使用法学硕士，您可以手动输入提示，只需在 Discord 上获取额外的指导和提示即可。就背景而言，到目前为止，我只花了 5 美元，已经支​​持了 50 多个视频，而且我还有剩余的积分，所以这是非常划算的。

🚀 快速入门

  1. 上传参考图片

  2. 加载您的音频文件

  3. 设置您的文件夹名称（例如，歌曲标题）。

  4. 填写提示创建者字段（风格、情绪、镜头等）。

  5. 打跑——其他一切都是自动化的。

    • 工作流程将自动队列中间运行对于长音频文件。

    • 对于最终通过，它将告诉您哪些群组要静音.

    • 只需按照屏幕上的说明操作，再次点击运行，工作流程就会自动完成该过程。 （您不必等待跑步结束。您只需静音并再次点击跑步即可。）

🎵 创意工作流程提示

就像真正的音乐视频一样，您不必坚持一次通过。你可以使用不同的参考图像或样式多次运行同一音频文件— 例如：

  • 一通与主唱作为表演者。

  • 另一张通行证包含乐队成员或配角。

  • 额外通过不同的实验主题、服装或相机风格.

稍后，您可以将这些单独的视频编辑在一起、在表演之间切换或混合视觉情绪——这正是专业音乐视频通过多次拍摄制作的方式。

📦 所需的自定义节点

该工作流程依赖于一组我专门为此工作流程构建的自定义节点.
您需要在运行工作流程之前安装它们：

👉 ComfyUI-VRGameDevGirl 自定义节点 (GitHub)

它们也可以通过管理器安装。

这些节点处理：

  • 音频分割、转录和自动排队

  • 智能文件夹管理和元数据跟踪。

  • 多次运行项目的弹出说明。

  • 场景同步和帧调整以实现 HuMo 兼容性。

  • 视频合并等等。

👉 加入 Discord 社区以获得支持、提示和技巧。

✅ 总结

此工作流程专为创作者、音乐家和视觉故事讲述者谁想要合并AI 视觉与音乐。借助自动转录、智能提示处理和无缝视频组装，您可以专注于创意方向而工作流程则负责处理繁重的工作。

🎬 AI Music Video Workflow (ComfyUI)

Turn your favorite tracks into fully AI-generatedcinematic music videos— automatically right inside ComfyUI -NO POST EDITING NEEDED.
This workflow takes areference imageand anaudio file, then generates a lip synced video that matches lyrics, mood, and scene dynamics and is 95% fully automated.

For some reason most of the example videos are not showing up, guessing they are too long. You can find them allhere

High Level walkthrough can be foundhere

Need help or have questions?Please reach out through discord

✨ What It Does

  • 🎭 Keeps yourreference imageas the main performer across all scenes.

  • 🎶 Splits audio into lyric-synced snippets for perfect timing.

  • 🖋️ Uses a custom Prompt creator node that sends custom instructions to an LLM node to build cinematic prompts from the lyrics and your style choices.

  • 🎥 Generates scene-by-scene visuals, then combines them into a seamless final video.

The samples I provided were all created inside ComfyUI with NO post edits.

On a 5090 it took around 2 hours for the full song.

More examples can be foundhereand more will be added as I make them.

🔧 Key Features

  • Reference Image Control– Import your character photo (headshot recommended) it auto-removes the background, and resizes for clean framing.

  • Audio Handling– Automatic vocal/instrument separation, Whisper V3 transcription, advanced settings for lyric overlap, and fallback options.

  • Prompt Creator– Flexible scene builder with fields for style, theme, lighting, camera motion, outfits, and more to get a custom look

  • Auto Queueing– Handles multi-run videos seamlessly for long audio files.

  • Final Render Automation– Collects all video chunks, merges them, and saves your finished video asFINAL_VIDEO.mp4.

  • This workflow uses the Native Gemini LLM API nodeby default, which receives detailed instructions generated by the Prompt Creator node. You can swap Gemini out for another LLM if you prefer, but the instruction sets are fairly complex, and most local models struggle to follow them reliably. If you’d rather not use an LLM at all, you can manually enter prompts instead—just reach out on Discord for extra guidance and tips. For context, I’ve spent only $5 so far, which has powered 50+ videos, and I still have credit left—so it’s been very cost-effective.

🚀 Quick Start

  1. Upload reference image

  2. Load your audio file

  3. Set your folder name(e.g., the song title).

  4. Fill in Prompt Creator fields(style, mood, shots, etc.).

  5. Hit Run— everything else is automated.

    • The workflow willauto-queue middle runsfor long audio files.

    • For the final pass, it willtell you which groups to mute.

    • Simply follow the on-screen instructions, hit run again, and the workflow finishes the process automatically. (You do not have to wait for runs to finish. You just mute and hit run once more.)

🎵 Creative Workflow Tip

Just like real music videos, you don’t have to stick to one pass. You canrun the same audio file multiple times with different reference images or styles— for example:

  • One pass with thelead singeras the performer.

  • Another pass featuring aband memberor supporting character.

  • Additional passes experimenting with differentthemes, outfits, or camera styles.

Later, you canedit these separate video runs together, cutting between performances or blending visual moods — exactly how professional music videos are produced with multiple takes.

📦 Required Custom Nodes

This workflow relies on a set ofcustom nodes I built specifically for this workflow.
You’ll need to install them before running the workflow:

👉 ComfyUI-VRGameDevGirl Custom Nodes (GitHub)

They can also be installed via the manager.

These nodes handle:

  • Audio splitting, transcription, and auto-queueing

  • Smart folder management and metadata tracking.

  • Popup instructions for multi-run projects.

  • Scene sync and frame adjustments for HuMo compatibility.

  • Video combining and more.

👉 Join the discord community for support, tips and tricks.

✅ In Summary

This workflow is designed forcreators, musicians, and visual storytellerswho want to mergeAI visuals with music. With automatic transcription, smart prompt handling, and seamless video assembly, you can focus oncreative directionwhile the workflow handles the heavy lifting.
